units.title: Unit 2: How We Express Ourselves
units.subtitle: Persuasion, Media, and Communication
units.description: Explore how we express ideas, persuade others, and present strong evidence.

strategies.title: Ethos (Trust & Credibility)
strategies.explanation: Ethos shows your reader that you are trustworthy, experienced, and knowledgeable about your topic!

starters.starter: You can trust me when I say ......
examples: You can trust me when I say this is the tastiest ice cream in town.
You can trust me when I say these stickers stick perfectly without ripping.
You can trust me when I say my popcorn is the best in town.
I have been collecting and designing colorful stickers for years.
I have been practicing making ice cream for a long time.
I have been baking delicious cookies with my grandmother since I was five.
I have worked hard in the kitchen choosing only fresh ingredients to make every scoop.
I have worked hard to test this is the most fun game for everyone.
I have worked hard making sure my nachos are perfectly crispy.

starters.starter: You can believe me when I say ......
examples: You can believe me when I say these homemade treats are made with real care.
You can believe me when I say these stickers are top quality.
You can believe me when I say you will love my nachos.
I promise you can believe in the quality of my fresh ice cream.
I promise that you will want more of my ice cream.
I promise these toys are safe and easy for everyone to use.

strategies.title: Logos (Facts & Logic)
strategies.explanation: Logos uses logic, clear facts, and strong reasoning to prove to your reader why your idea makes complete sense!

examples: Studies show that fidget clickers help students maintain focus and lower stress during class.
Studies show that drinking fresh juice improves energy levels and helps kids stay active all day.
Studies show that squishy toys provide calming sensory input that improves mood.
It contains 100% real fruit juice, no added refined sugar, and full daily vitamins.
It contains no artificial colorings, no strange preservatives, and real melted cheddar cheese.
It contains durable non-toxic silicone that easily restores its shape after thousands of squeezes.
Doesn't it make sense to choose a snack that is both crunchy and packed with real energy?
Doesn't it make sense to buy a silent clicker that lasts all school year without breaking?
Doesn't it make sense to pick a drink that tastes delicious and keeps your body healthy?
It makes sense to select squishies because they are affordable, reusable, and great for sharing.
It makes sense to buy clickers because they are quiet, durable, and practical for learning.
It makes sense to serve fresh nachos made with quality ingredients everyone enjoys.
